jd_text: Cong ty tuyen Backend Engineer (Python) cho he thong dich vu web quy mo lon. Cong viec: thiet ke va phat trien REST API bang Python (FastAPI/Django), toi uu truy van co so du lieu quan he (PostgreSQL), trien khai bang Docker tren AWS, dam bao do tin cay va hieu nang. Yeu cau: tot nghiep dai hoc nganh CNTT hoac tuong duong, it nhat 2 nam kinh nghiem backend voi Python va SQL. Uu tien ung vien co kinh nghiem microservices, CI/CD, va he thong tai cao.
